paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, work-thumbnail backings

newsprint.$description: Newsprint — Primary text, dominant hairline borders, image outlines

faint-gray.$description: Faint Gray — Muted text, secondary borders, caption-scale copy

typesetter-gray.$description: Typesetter Gray — Display-weight text, large heading fills where contrast is intentionally reduced

rule-gray.$description: Rule Gray — Hairline dividers, icon strokes, light borders

ink.$description: Ink — Nav text and nav borders, maximum-contrast moments

press-black.$description: Press Black — Nav foreground, slight off-black for body nav links

footnote.$description: Footnote — Outlined link borders, secondary link text — a quiet hover/focus state

hi-liter-wash.$description: Hi-Liter Wash — The single chromatic moment — a warm pale-yellow surface used as a full-bleed band, never as fill or text

instrumentsans.$description: All display, heading, nav, and caption text. Condensed sans with very tight tracking. The 86px/0.83 line-height is the signature move — type runs together vertically, producing the broadsheet effect. Substitute with 'Archivo Narrow' (600, 700) or 'Roboto Condensed' (700).

arial.$description: Body, metadata, link copy, and supporting micro-text. Tracked extremely tight (-0.214em ≈ -3px at 14px), which is a counter-intuitive choice for body — it reads as a typesetter pulling body to match the display weight. Substitute with system Arial or 'Helvetica Neue'.
